title: Send touch
description: One queued outreach touch. Shared by sends/queue/*.json (email, sent by smtp-send.py), sends/linkedin/*.json (channel: linkedin, sent manually), and sends/rejected/*.json (moved here unmodified by the copy-evaluator gate -- same shape). See send-touch-format-test.schema.json for the format-test-send.yml variant, which extends this with 3 required keys (original_to, reply_to, campaign).

body.description: plain text, one line per paragraph -- never hard-wrapped

original_to.description: format-test-send.yml only: the real prospect address the test send stands in for
